entities.summary: Jurchen Jin, a notable figure in the history of China, associated with Song Dynasty (1127–1279). Preceded by Jingkang Incident — Jurchen capture the Song emperor and sack Kaifeng and Wang Anshi's sweeping economic reforms provoke factional strife. Their legacy influenced Battle of Yamen — Mongol fleet destroys the last Song resistance and Kublai Khan proclaims the Yuan dynasty with its capital at Dadu (Beijing).
